verses.author: model_A
verses.text: The last snow melts from the roof tiles one drop at a time.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
Somewhere a gutter fills
with the sound of small change spent —
spring's quiet transaction

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a sparrow counts the coins,
finds the sum enough
to build a nest with

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
it never asked for interest —
just mud, straw, a little sun
to make the debt worth owing

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the roof holds still,
lending its warm shadow
to whatever wants to grow there

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
come morning, no ledger —
just wings deciding
where the light gets spent

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the sparrow spends it all
on one long note,
gone before the change comes back

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
nothing left in the branch now
but the shape where the singing was —
still worth something, that emptiness
